summary: OpenVibe.MediaHub: openvibe.download as a private drive. Account-only uploads stream into OpenVibe.Media (a plain form up to 256 MB, resumable parts beyond). Files are private. Share links expire in 1 hour to 7 days, need a signed-in downloader and can be limited to named accounts (matched by subject). Reports suspend a share for staff. Downloads are always sandboxed attachments. Per-person quotas, and account export and deletion (ADR-033). openvibe.pics and openvibe.video are parked and redirect to openvibe.network.
works: Sign-in with OpenVibe.Network (PKCE S256, httpOnly session cookies); pages server-rendered, complete without JavaScript
Uploads: a plain form streamed to disk with its sha256 (up to 256 MB), and resumable chunked uploads (8 MB parts) through Media multipart
Private files and folders, per-person limits (2 GB stored, 512 MB per file, 50 uploads a day, 20 live shares)
Share links: 1 hour to 7 days, revocable, counted, sign-in required, optional named accounts (Network subjects only)
Reports: 3 distinct people or one report of illegal content suspend a share; staff restore or remove (Media object deleted)
Downloads: attachment, nosniff, sandbox CSP, real type only for a safe list, filename* for any script, Range resume
Parked domains: openvibe.pics and openvibe.video redirect to openvibe.network in nginx; no request reaches the app
Account export and deletion (ADR-033) through openvibe-sdk/account-data; subscriptions created at boot
Per-caller and per-address limits; readiness (database required); metrics on loopback
notYet: Uploads on openvibe.pics (images, albums, embeds) and openvibe.video (watch pages, captions, playlists): both domains are parked until scanning (hash lists, malware) and abuse intake shared with Media holds exist
Public (signed-out) share links: deliberately not offered while there is no scanning
